mapper.select: SELECT ASSET_ID, NAME, CATEGORY, COMPANY, STATUS, IMAGE, MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, USAGE_TIME, LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT, CASE WHEN IS_DELETED = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IS_DELETED FROM ASSET WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND ( (START_TIME <= #{startAt} AND END_TIME > #{startAt}) OR (START_TIME < #{endAt} AND END_TIME >= #{endAt}) OR (START_TIME >= #{startAt} AND END_TIME <= #{endAt}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION ( ASSET_ID, USER_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, PURPOSE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_STATE, ADDRESS_CITY, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{assetId}, #{userId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{purpose}, #{address}, #{addressState}, #{addressCity}, #{status} )
